summary.text: Dina Neal is a Democratic member of the Nevada Senate, representing District 4 in Clark County. She has served in the Senate since 2020, after serving in the Nevada Assembly from 2011, and the legislature lists her occupation as professor.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Neal was born in North Las Vegas and lists Chaparral High School in Las Vegas under her education.

She earned a bachelor of arts in political science from Southern University and A&M College in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and a juris doctorate from Southern University Law Center, and her page lists work as an adjunct professor at Nevada State College.
Neal served in the Nevada Assembly from 2011 to 2020 and was first elected to the Senate in November 2020.
Her page lists her as chair of the Taxation Committee during the 2017 and 2019 Assembly sessions, and as a member of the Senate Jobs and Economy Committee.
It also lists her as Region 12 chair of the National Black Caucus of State Legislators from 2016 to 2022.
